offers.title: Standard Business Website
phrases: how much does a website cost
can you build a website for my business
offers.summary: A professionally designed business website for organisations that need a modern online presence without the cost of a fully custom platform.
offers.related_response_fragment: For businesses looking for a focused website starting point, the current Standard Business Website offer is £599.
response_fragments: We currently offer a Standard Business Website package from £599.
It is designed for businesses that need a professional online presence without the cost of a fully custom platform.
The package includes up to five pages, a contact form, mobile-responsive design, basic SEO setup, Google Maps integration, three design review rounds, and deployment and launch support.
It does not include custom software, membership systems, complex integrations, or e-commerce functionality.

offers.title: Introductory AI Visibility Audit
phrases: how much is an ai visibility audit
what is included in the 99 audit
do you have an ai visibility audit offer
offers.summary: A focused introductory review of how clearly an organisation can be found, understood, and represented across a sample of AI-assisted search environments.
offers.related_response_fragment: The introductory AI Visibility Audit is £99. The standard combined AI Visibility and AEO Audit remains £299.
includes: Representative AI and search visibility observations
response_fragments: The introductory AI Visibility Audit is currently available for £99, subject to limited availability.
It reviews representative AI and search visibility, the website's technical and entity signals, a small competitor sample, and the highest-priority next actions.
The client receives prioritised findings and a concise written action plan.
Implementation and ongoing management are not included. The standard combined AI Visibility and AEO Audit remains £299, and no ranking, citation, or recommendation is guaranteed.
